races.name: F Ball Stick With It Chasing Excellence Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: COUNTRY MILE has yet to have a clear shot at racing but he's looked pretty talented on occasions and with his year-long absence no real concern given the yard he represents, he can get off the mark over fences. This trip is surely on the sharp side for O'Moore Park so chase debutant The Gray Ghost may chase the selection home.

runners.note: Dual novice hurdle winner who made a promising start over fences when second to Alnilam in this race a year ago. Unable to build on that later in the month at Cheltenham and off since but he's in expert hands and retains

Plenty of at least respectable handicap efforts to his name, including when sixth in the Plate at Cheltenham and seventh in the Topham at Aintree during the spring. Made mistakes when well held in the Killarney National
Doubled hurdles tally at Newcastle in February and shaped as though in good form when hitting the frame both starts during the spring. Has the size for chasing so no surprise were he to up his game.

races.name: Final Furlong Podcast With 1xBet.ie Irish European Breeders Fund Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: The market should reveal plenty here but the vote goes to Aidan O'Brien's newcomer SWEETLY, who is a sister to the stable's Irish Derby hero Benvenuto Cellini no less, and looks a very interesting proposition on her first go on the racecourse. Both Pirate Anne Bonny and Little Darling shaped well on their respective debuts at Naas and Leopardstown and can also have a say, while the selection's sta

runners.note: Foaled March 14. 26,000 gns yearling, Bayside Boy filly. Dam, 2-y-o 1m winner, half-sister to useful 2-y-o 7f winner Stela Star. The betting can prove an accurate guide.
80/1 and green when thirteenth of 15 in minor event here (6f, good to soft) on debut 21 days ago. Can build on it here but she needs to.
Ghaiyyath filly shaped well when fourth of 14 in minor event over C&D (good to firm) on debut in August, best work finish under hand riding. Sure to improve.
Took a step forward from her debut with sixth of 10 in maiden claimer at Naas (1m, good to soft, 50/1) 17 days ago. May do better still.

20,000 gns foal, 45,000 gns yearling. A half-sister to several winners, including French 10.5f-1½m winner Eneryda and useful 1½m-2m winner Bahadur. Dam French 1½m winner. This Golden Horn filly needs considering.
Sent off 28/1 but made a promising start with fifth of 14 in maiden at Leopardstown (7f, good to firm) in August, nearest finish. This Night of Thunder filly is open to progress and rates a player.

Foaled May 14. Frankel filly. Closely related to useful 1m winner Platoon and half-sister to smart 2-y-o 7f/7.4f winner January. Dam winner up to 1m. In excellent hands and makes plenty of appeal on paper.

Promising clear second of 21 in maiden at Naas (6f, good to soft) on debut 17 days ago, first home in her group. This Blackbeard filly merits serious consideration with improvement very much on the cards.
Foaled April 23. Frankel filly. Sister to Irish Derby winner Benvenuto Cellini and useful winner up to 11.6f Giselle. Rates a most interesting newcomer for top yard.

races.name: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: With the Twiston-Davies stable hitting form in recent weeks, GENTLE OCEAN, who was runner-up in an Irish point during the winter, may well be the answer on Rules debut. A Chara will go very close if repeating her Southwell run, while In The Trenches may have more to offer for Jennie Candlish.

runners.note: Belatedly opened account in 19f Downpatrick maiden hurdle in June and having left one good yard for another, he travelled powerfully tackling 3m for the first time (fitted with a tongue tie) when landing 3-runner handica

€20,000 3-y-o, £50,000 5-y-o, fifth foal, dam unraced half-sister to top-class hurdler (stayed 21f) The New One and fairly useful hurdler/chaser (stays 3¼m) The Newest One. In-form yard have had success with the family a
Limited hurdler who makes mistakes and is set to struggle out of low-grade handicap company.

£70,000 Irish point recruit who stepped up on Rules debut fourth when a clear second to odds-on winner Strong Run at Southwell (20.5f, good to soft) in December. Off since but that is the best form on offer and hopes are
Modest winner up to 1½m on the Flat and similar level over hurdles this summer, placed all 3 starts. Could do with brushing up her jumping slightly but is capable of making her presence felt again.
Bred for stamina and little in the way of promise in various company.
Placed a couple of times for Henry de Bromhead. Won a point ahead of switch to Dan Skelton but rare tame start for the yard when brushed aside at Uttoxeter 19 days ago.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: Not a strong maiden by any means and this could be the day that ASTELIA finally gets off the mark having gained the reputation of being a serial bridesmaid. Mastertown Miss got back on track at Ballinrobe recently in a first-time hood, she could give the selection most to think about. Katie Can't Count can edge out Run For Power for third.

runners.note: Fair handicapper on Flat for Dylan Cunha. Not seen for 17 months ahead of this hurdling debut for new connections so probably best watched. First-time hood applied.

Showed improved form tried tongue tied back in a bumper after 5 months off when winning at Killarney (17f, good) in July. Showed more than first time up in this sphere when fourth of 17 at Listowel (2m, good to soft) 10

Prolific runner-up in this discipline (has filled that position 4 of last 5 starts) but ran no sort of race returned to the level at Listowel (1¾m, good to soft) just under a fortnight ago. Big shout of belatedly getting

Not seen to best effect in bumper and having made an underwhelming hurdling debut (fell when held 2 out), shaped as if she's got a bigger performance in her if learning to settle when sixth of 15 at Downpatrick (2¼m, goo
Tailed off on both completed starts over hurdles and seemingly being brought along with handicaps in mind.
Tailed off in bumper and yet to better modest form in 3 maiden hurdles. May be handicaps where she takes off but certainly worth a market glance nonetheless with cheekpieces fitted.

Workforce filly. Dam unraced half-sister to fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser (stayed 2¾m) Mister Hotelier and fairly useful hurdler/fair chaser who became ungenuine (stayed 2½m) Blackwater King. Hooded for debut.
Back on track tried over a longer trip returned to hurdling when fourth of 15 in maiden at Ballinrobe (2¼m, good) just over 3 weeks ago. First-time hood goes on and fancied to be in the mix.

Shaped like a stayer when fourth in bumper at Listowel on debut in May and might have needed the run 3 months on when seventh of 10 at Kilbeggan (19f, good to soft) last time. Market check advised on hurdling debut.

races.name: Welcome To Family Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: JENTOBELLO has gone close on several occasions already and can finally make amends here at the expense of Fine Thing.

runners.note: Won first 2 starts over hurdles, latest when getting the better of the odds-on favourite in match at Stratford. Down in trip and faced competition for the lead when fourth of 7 in novice hurdle at Newton Abbot last time.
Won both outings in bumpers and made frame all 6 starts over hurdles, latest when beaten 2 lengths to Nightflyer in maiden at Uttoxeter. Rates a serious player here with first-time blinkers now on.
Maiden pointer who's been well held both starts over hurdles. Hard to see anything changing here.

races.name: Bermingham Cameras Irish European Breeders Fund (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict: HMAS PERTH sets a clear standard on the form of his Doncaster second and he looks the obvious pick to go one place better. Stablemate Paraguay is much respected on debut, with Cracks And Sparks also on the shortlist.

runners.note: Foaled March 12. Elzaam colt. Half-brother to 1½m winner Colonial Love and a winner abroad. Dam, 7f winner, half-sister to top-class winner up to 1m Canford Cliffs. Yard would not be associated with debut winners.
The Gurkha gelding is the second foal out of a dam who only ran in bumpers.  80/1, last of 11 in maiden at Naas (7f, good to soft) on debut 17 days ago.

18,000 gns foal, 26,000 gns yearling, Cracksman colt. Showed plenty to work on despite signs of inexperience when fifth of 15 in maiden at Naas (7f, good to soft) on debut 17 days ago. Should improve.
Has run to a fair level both starts to date, a never-nearer fourth of 13 in a 6f maiden here 8 days ago. Remains with potential given step back up in trip is likely to suit.

Improved on debut form when second of 10 in maiden at Doncaster (1m) 22 days ago, only narrowly denied by another promising type. Holds a Group 1 entry and he's the one to beat with further progress to come.
60,000 gns 2-y-o. Study of Man colt who shaped as if needing the experience when sixth of 15 in maiden at Gowran (7f, good to soft) on debut 33 days ago. Should have more to offer.
Cracksman gelding who again shaped as if in need of time and distance when twelfth of 13 in maiden at this C&D (heavy) 7 days ago.
€200,000 breeze-up purchase but shaped as if he would benefit from his first outing when seventh of 18 in maiden at Naas (6f) in July. Could see a better showing this time around.

Foaled April 27. 45,000 gns yearling, Zarak gelding out of Group 1-winning mare. Closely related to 7.6f winner Narak and very smart 1m-9f winner Valiant Prince, and half-brother to smart 1¼m-1½m winner Klassique. Worth
Foaled May 4. Frankel colt. Dam, 1m listed winner, sister to smart winner up to 1¼m Antilles. Of obvious interest on debut given yard and pedigree.

22,000 gns yearling, €50,000 2-y-o. Half-brother to 3 winners, including very smart French 6f/7f winner Spinning Memories (by Arcano) and smart winner up to 7f Ramazan (2-y-o 5f/6f winner, by Kodiac). Dam unraced. Should

€12,000 foal, €28,000 yearling, Persian Force gelding outran long odds when fourth of 15 in minor event at this course (6.3f, good to soft) on debut 21 days ago. Learned on the job there and he holds place claims, for a

Third of 9 in maiden at Gowran (7f, good to soft) on debut and took a step forward faced with a more difficult task when 4 lengths sixth of 7 to Dancing Destiny in listed race (22/1) at Naas (1m, good). Off 92 days.

races.name: F Ball 140th Anniversary Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: An expensive purchase out of Irish bumpers prior to last season, GOVERNORS ROCK may well be good enough to make a successful start over hurdles. Fairly useful Flat recruit Analogical stands out as the danger, while any support for point winner Shah is likely to be telling.

runners.note: Showed ability on the first of 2 bumper starts. Lame on hurdling debut in August 2025 and offered little on return at Newton Abbot (2¾m) latest. Probably one for handicaps now.

Beat a subsequent bumper/maiden hurdle winner when successful in pair of bumpers for Mark Fahey. Changed hands for £100,000 and disappointing (albeit highly tried) in listed/Grade 2 bumpers for new connections last seaso
Well beaten all 5 starts to date, latterly from out of the weights in first-time hood/tongue tie on handicap debut at Sedgefield.

€12,500 3-y-o, £55,000 5-y-o, Walzertakt gelding. Half-brother to French 1¼m-1½m winner Coco Caline. Dam 1¼m winner in France. Easy winner third start in Irish points (May 2026). One of the more interesting types in here
Fairly useful winning stayer for Sir Mark Prescott. The clear pick of those with Flat form and certainly looks the type to make a hurdler. Likely to run a big race on hurdling debut for a good yard.
Modest maiden on Flat. Hasn't achieved anything in a couple of novice runs and is probably a handicap project.
Fair on the Flat for Alan King/Eve Johnson Houghton. Left previous connections for just 5,000 gns prior to finishing down the field on hurdling debut/return. Entitled to still need this.
Fairly useful 1½m winner for Ralph Beckett in 2025. Form went wrong way for current yard this year and may be one for the longer-term now hurdling.
Flat-bred mare who is again turned out quickly, having shown little on either start to date.
At long odds when well held both maiden starts. Another quick turnaround suggests she's a handicap project for top connections.

races.name: Seamus Weldon John Deere Dealer Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: COLIN’S FRIEND improved in a competitive handicap on stable debut at Galway last time and, with further progress likely, he looks worth chancing in an ordinary affair. The Border Boy is well treated at present and looked set to go close when making a last-flight error here last month, so rates the main danger, while Granlahan and Kingdom Calling are also respected.

runners.note: Bumper winner but his third at Limerick on handicap debut last Christmas is his only effort of note over hurdles. Claims if returning to that form but a leap of faith required on that front.

Travelled well when off the mark in 17-runner handicap hurdle at Listowel last autumn. Hasn't matched that level since, but has hinted at a revival on last 2 starts and now finds herself just 1 lb higher than her last wi
Bits and pieces of promise in handicaps but bled at Sligo on his penultimate start and again backed out of things quickly at Bellewstown last time. Makes debut for new yard.
Showed improved form starting out for current yard when fourth of 20 to Inthenickoftime on handicap debut at Galway in September. In good hands and looks open to further progress.

Hinted at more ability when mid-division in a trio of maidens but can have handicap debut effort ignored after suffering significant interference. Tongue strap back on and remains open to improvement.
Fair maiden on Flat but no impact all 5 starts over hurdles.

Turned in best effort when second in 2m Limerick handicap hurdle last autumn. Effort at Cork in July is best excused and remains an air of untapped potential about him as a hurdler. Wears first-time tongue strap and need

Took advantage of a career-low mark when winning Tramore handicap chase in August and shaped as if still in good form when 13¾ lengths fifth of 15 to Marian Avenue in handicap hurdle at Listowel last time. One to conside

A 5-time winner, who registered the last of those successes at Tipperary last season. Returns after 10 months off from that same winning mark and with a good-value 5-lb claimer booked, but her record when fresh is mixed
Remains a maiden but has been proving consistent, making the frame for the fourth start in a row when ¾-length second of 18 to Glin Road Boy at Listowel. Should be thereabouts once again.

Went off the boil over hurdles last year before an inauspicious start over fences at Sligo and showed nothing from well out of the handicap in mares event at Ballinrobe on return from 11-month absence.

Two-time winner who has shown nothing since returning from a lengthy absence. Wears first-time cheekpieces and booking of good-value conditional catches the eye but very hard to recommend unless the market speaks firmly
Remains winless over hurdles but placed at Sligo and Clonmel on first 2 starts this season. Shaped as if still in good form at Ballinrobe on latest outing, still in touch when falling 2 out.
Stepped up on her return/yard debut when fourth of 16 in handicap hurdle at Cork (17f, good to soft) in August. Below that level upped in trip last time.
Fairly useful form on Flat in France for Andre Fabre back in 2022. Off 3 years and has failed to better poor form in 9 starts over hurdles.

Cork handicap hurdle winner who produced his best effort over fences when fourth of 10 in handicap at Tramore (2¾m) in May. Looked back in form when 1½ lengths fifth of 15 to Pure Logic at this course last time, bad mist

Sole success came in Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last summer. Has gone backwards from a promising second in handicap hurdle at Wexford in May and has cut little ice in handicap chases on last 2 starts, unseating on latest. R

Dual winner over hurdles. Creditable third of 16 in handicap hurdle at Tipperary (16.9f, good to soft) last spring before running poorly at Wexford. Makes debut for new connections now returning from 15-month absence. RE

Fair maiden hurdler who has finished in the frame on 3 occasions this season, third of 14 in maiden at Wexford on third occasion in August. Best excused last run after stumbling early on the final circuit. Needs to impro

races.name: Percy's Racing Dream Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: EVALUATION certainly comes with risks attached, but he looked to be crying out for this longer trip when running well in stronger events last year, so he's awarded the vote. Course specialist Heart Above has to be high on the shortlist, while Ballynoe Boy will be of firm interest if taking up this engagement after getting a hat-trick up at Hexham on Friday.

runners.note: Strong traveller who can promise more than he delivers. Capitalised on a reduced mark in good fashion at Sedgefield (17f) in March, winning the race for the second consecutive year. Handicapper taken no chances with an 8

Useful on the Flat for Lucinda Russell in 2024. Crying out for this step up in trip over hurdles when hitting the frame in a trio of 2m handicaps last season. Tricky to assess back hurdling (well beaten at long odds both

Fairly useful type. Has a second and 2 wins from his last 3 hurdle starts, again capitalising on a lower mark in smooth style at Newcastle in October (3m). Still 2 lb below his chase mark and did make a winning seasonal

Isn't the force he was when landing an emphatic C&D success in Class 2 handicap in March 2025 (his latest win). Has given a chance by the handicapper, though, dropped another 2 lb for his 9¼-length fifth in a slightly be

Needed every yard of the trip to capitalise on a drop in grade in C&D hurdle in May. No show twice at Cartmel subsequently and was given a considerate return from 9-week break here last time. Excellent track record (3 wi

Has got his act together over hurdles of late, his Bangor success well advertised while he got the hat-trick up at Hexham over this trip on Friday despite errors returning. Big player again under a penalty.

Underlined a positive start over hurdles when runner-up in a 2½m Hexham maiden last November. Didn't go on as expected in handicaps and now 7 lb lower than his opening mark as a result. Considered for yard who've fired i
Perth regular who won back-to-back 3m handicaps there in July. Didn't beat a rival on either start over the same C&D last month, though, and his record here isn't anything special.

Staying type whose latest success came in Go North Final over C&D (soft) in March 2025. Ran a typical race on first start for 4 months here last time, outpaced/plugged on (beaten 12¾ lengths), again shaping as though rea

Remains with sole win from 15 starts. Hasn't built on the promise of his third over 2¼m here in April. Seemingly no excuses at Cartmel (17f) last time, either, and he has something to prove from well out of the weights f

races.name: Coolmore Sioux Nation Concorde Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: The improving LOUGHREA can take the step up into listed company in his stride and complete the 4-timer. The likeable Big Gossey looks set to add another positive effort at this track to his record and can pose the biggest threat ahead of Carolina Jetstream.

runners.note: Remarkable course specialist with 10 wins here including 4 over C&D. Pulled clear with an improving 3-y-o when ¾-length second in the 7-runner Renaissance Stakes at this course (6f, heavy, 12/1) 7 days ago. Leading claim

Dual 6f winner here, the latest in March. Stepped up on his return from a 4-month break when fourth of 10 in handicap at this C&D (good to soft) 8 days ago but likely needs more again to make the breakthrough at this lev

Went close in a 6f Group 3 here last season and stepped up on his return when 2 lengths fourth of 15 to Mission Central in listed race at Naas (5f, good), Off another 160 days since but he's a player at this level if ful

Improving sort who got off the mark at the third time of asking in a 1m Curragh maiden in June. Has since completed the hat-trick with a pair of stylish handicap wins over that trip at Leoparstown and this course. Drop t
Narrow winner of a listed race at Naas in May but hasn't been able to land a serious blow in Group 3 company on her last 3 outings and this looks a good race for the level.

Siyouni colt was much improved from his debut when landing 13-runner maiden over C&D (heavy) in March. Not ideally placed on the wing but improved after a 6-month break when fourth of 9 in a C&D minor event last week. Ca

Won 14-runner maiden at Galway (7f, good to soft) in July and before a respectable sixth of 11 to Suzie Songs in listed race at Cork the following month. Resumed progress with a fast-finishing third of 17 in handicap at

Looked on the up when doubling his tally in 6f handicap at Listowel in May and resumed his progress after a 3-month break when a good second of 9 in minor event (14/1) at this C&D (good to soft) 8 days ago. Hood worn the

Runner-up in a 1m Group 2 here in May (66/1) and ran to a similar level when filling the same position in a listed event at Killarney in August. Out of her depth in the Matron Stakes last time but should prove competitiv
Dual winner in August last year, including a Tipperary Group 3. All the better for return when second at the Curragh (1m) in April but below par more recently and others remain more persuasive.

races.name: F Ball 140th Anniversary Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: The Twiston-Davies yard couldn't be going much better at present so CURRENT EDITION is selected to continue their hot streak and make a winning return having gone down by a nose first time up in this discipline back in the spring. Sytadel bumped into a subsequent winner starting out for this yard recently, so he looks an obvious danger, with stable-switcher Larzac rounding off the shortlist.

runners.note: Fell sole start in Irish points and having looked in need of experience in 2 bumpers last winter, took a step forward following a breathing operation when nose-second of 8 in novice at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) on hurdli
Borderline useful Flat performer (stays 1½m) last year. Hasn't hit those heights in 6 starts for new connections, including when well held on hurdling debut at Cartmel in July. Can only be watched.

Attracted support and posted much his best effort for Willie Mullins when fourth of 19 in handicap hurdle over longer trip at Cork back in April. Well beaten at the Punchestown Festival later that month and he's switched

Little impact in 3 bumpers and given a considerate introduction over hurdles on his first outing for 5 months/since leaving P. Kiely when fourth of 6 in novice at Stratford (2m, good to firm) last month. Hood applied and

Only made the track 4 times for Roger Varian, taking a small step forward when second on handicap debut in September 2025. Raced too freely even with a hood fitted on recent yard/hurdling debut at Plumpton so tough to en

Failed to meet market expectations first time up when eighth of 10 in bumper at Worcester (2m, good) on debut 6 weeks ago, not enjoying the clearest of passages but essentially shaping as if ill-suited to the test of spe

Easy winner of Le Lion-d'Angers maiden on second outing on the Flat for Xavier Blanchet in May 2025. Tongue tied for his hurdling debut and produced an encouraging effort after 16 months off when second of 12 in maiden a

Passing Glance gelding who ran more like his £5,000 sales price had suggested he might rather than the betting when seventh of 8 in bumper at Worcester (2m, good to soft, 9/2) last month. Makes the quick switch to hurdli

Nathaniel filly who showed promise amidst signs of being headstrong when third of 9 in bumper at Worcester (2m, good) last month. Makes hurdling debut and entitled to progress provided the lid can be kept on. Yard second
Limited Flat performer at up to 1¼m who offered little with a hood retained for her switch to hurdling at Plumpton a fortnight ago. Looks an easy swerve.

races.name: Gleneagle Arena Killarney Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict: Cases can be made for most of these, but LIPS FREEDOM resumed his progress when going down narrowly at Navan recently so Andrew Kinirons' 6-y-o earns the tentative nod returned to novice company. Cocofred can't have been right on his handicap debut, so he's worth another chance to get back on the up here, with Firebrand and Celtic Alliance taken to fight out minor honours.

runners.note: Listed bumper winner who confirmed previous promise over hurdles when winning 9-runner maiden at Sligo (2¼m, good) in mid-August, having plenty more left to give after settling much better than the favourite. Another jol

Much improved when winning at Downpatrick in March and defied an 11 lb higher mark over C&D in July. Couple of lesser efforts followed (including on Flat) but resumed progress when second of 13 at Navan (2m, good to soft

Continued a theme of progression over hurdles when winning 15-runner maiden at Roscommon in July by 4 lengths from Astelia. However, he ran too badly to be true having been sent off favourite on handicap debut last month
Confirmed previous promise back in maiden company when winning 15-runner event at Tramore (2m, good to soft) in late-May. Off since but no reason why he can't be competitive if fully tuned up.

Attracted strong late support in a change of headgear and finally got off the mark having been allowed the run of things in 20-runner maiden at Galway (17f, good to soft) last month, jumping fluently. Big shout if the he

Made a winning start in an ordinary juvenile maiden hurdle at Clonmel (2m) in April. Wasn't able to repeat that effort when third of 7 in mares' novice at Perth (2½m) later the same month, but it remains early days for h

Progressed again when winning 14-runner maiden at Wexford in August but failed to back that up switched to a handicap at Kilbeggan last time, doing too much in racing clear with one other for a fair portion of the race.

Much improved from debut with win in 13-runner maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe (17f, good) in July but got nowhere near to backing that up when tailed off at Kilbeggan (19f, good to soft) the following month. Has since moved

races.name: Justin & Susan Greig Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: TUPPENCE is the pick at the weights and is hard to oppose. Her stablemate Luna Grace may prove next best.

runners.note: Has yet to match his fairly useful Flat form (for Dermot Weld) over hurdles. Ran up to best in this sphere when fifth of 10 in novice at Market Rasen (21f, good to firm) in August. Steps back down in trip and has the che

Fair hurdler who was backed at long odds when landing 15-runner handicap at Ayr (2m, soft, 18/1) by 11 lengths to Lance Les Des when last seen in April with this jockey in the saddle. Has gone well fresh before and looks
Placed twice in mares maiden hurdles during 2023/24. Failed to improve on handicap debut at Sedgefield when last seen in May 2024. Can only be watched on return unless market speaks in her favour.
Third on all 6 of her starts, including last 3 over hurdles. Shaped with promise at Perth last time but has a bit to find with her older stablemate.

races.name: 1xBet.ie Proud Supporters Of Irish Racing Handicap
races.verdict: IAMIMMACULATE signalled he is ready to gain a first success for his current yard when runner-up at Listowel last time and looks the way to go here off a still handy-looking mark. Truth Be Told rates a big threat though on the back of a promising sixth in a big-field Leopardstown handicap last time, while Majestic King and Johnny Soda can also play a prominent role.

runners.note: Has failed to kick on since his reappearance second over 1m here but not totally disgraced in first-time cheekpieces when thirteenth of 22 in handicap here (1¼m, good to soft, 33/1) 21 days ago. Needs to build on it.
Positive start for new yard with win at Gowran in August but only sixteenth of 17 in handicap at Leopardstown (7f, good to firm) 22 days ago. Bounce back needed.
Below par this season but cheekpieces on for first time and better signs when fifth of 11 in listed race at Listowel (1m, good to soft) 12 days ago. Can take a step forward.

Has improved for current connections this year, scoring at Leopardstown in May and caught further back than ideal when a close sixth of 21 in valuable handicap there (13f) 22 days ago. Not without interest.
Scored at Cork in April but not proved easy to catch right since, retried in cheekpieces when a below-par eighth of 17 in handicap here (1m, good to soft) last time.
Progressive sort who registered a third win of the season in 1m handicap at Killarney in July. Posted a very good third of 22 in handicap here (1¼m, good to soft) 21 days ago. Firmly in the picture.
Fairly useful filly who shaped as if back in form when third of 9 in handicap at Down Royal in June. Faced a stiff task in first-time blinkers at Galway since and not out of things here.
Course winner. Suffered a poor run when seventeenth of 22 in handicap here (1¼m, good to soft) 21 days ago. Stable having good spell so he enters calculations.

Left Daniel McLoughlin after scoring at Naas last September. Made the frame for the third time for current yard with an improved second of 13 in handicap at Listowel (9f, good to soft) 13 days ago. Tongue strap refitted.
Lightly-raced sort who produced a career best when winning 8-runner maiden at Clonmel (1¼m, good) 18 days ago. Has more to do back in handicap company here though.
Got back on the up when readily doubling his tally in 15-runner handicap at Listowel (1m, good to soft) 13 days ago, admittedly well drawn. Hiked up 10 lb but still very much one to consider.

Lightly-raced sort who scored over C&D in April. Off 5 months (gelded) before posting a solid fifth of 7 in handicap at Listowel (1m, good to soft) 12 days ago. Can build on it over this slightly longer trip.

races.name: F Ball Established 1886 Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: In an open-looking handicap, the vote goes to ERNEST GRAY, who proved at least as good as ever when a comprehensive winner at Bangor last time. Smooth-travelling Divalabother will be ridden cold and could run into a place, with last year's winner Roger Pol likely to be thereabouts if on another going day.

runners.note: Strong traveller who progressed to win 5 times between June-August (including hat-trick success over C&D), his only defeat in that spell when splitting a couple of future winners here. Still in form when beaten 7½ length

Consistent sort. Proved at least as good as ever when recording a fourth career handicap hurdle success at Bangor (23f) last time, typically finding plenty for pressure. Looks capable of defying a career-high mark in his

Won this corresponding event last year (race fell apart) prior to completing a double at Hexham. First-time blinkers/switch to front running saw him emerge from the doldrums when 3¼-length second to Ernest Gray at Bangor

Veteran Loingseoir bagged this prize twice prior to that and heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Blue Blue Moon and Lady Arwen can also have a say in this highly competitive event.
